sections.heading: Run every client site from one console.
body: Spin up a host for each client, brand it as your own, control who can touch what, and bill it all from one place — without stitching a stack of tools together.

sections.heading: Most agencies run a different stack for every client — a builder here, a store there, analytics somewhere else. Aglyn puts every client site on one platform, so your team learns it once and reuses everything.

items.title: One console, every client
items.body: Add a host for each client site under your org, and switch between them without new logins.

items.title: Roles & per-site access
items.body: Org roles for your team, per-site collaborator seats for clients — a collaborator’s console shows only their site. Keep internal datasets and media off client sites with per-site sharing.

items.title: White-label sites, console & email
items.body: On the Agency plan, published sites, the console your clients sign into, and every transactional email carry your brand — right down to running the console on your own domain.

items.title: Reusable components & templates
items.body: Build a component once, or install a marketplace template, then reuse it across every client site.

items.title: One billing hub
items.body: Manage plans, seats, and hosts across all your clients from a single billing view.

items.title: Clean handoff
items.body: Give clients viewer or editor access to just their own site — and nothing else.

sections.heading: Design a system, not one-off sites.
body: Build components, layouts, and templates once, then reuse them across every client site. Update the source and the change flows everywhere — so ten client sites don’t mean ten times the work.

items.title: Reusable components
items.body: Author a component once and instance it across every client site.

items.title: Templates & starters
items.body: Install marketplace templates, or save your own as a starting point.

items.title: Consistent theming
items.body: Set brand tokens per client so every page stays on-brand.

sections.heading: From pitch to handoff, in one place.

items.title: Create a host per client
items.body: Spin up a new site under your org for each client, on whatever plan fits them.

items.title: Brand it and build it
items.body: Design on the canvas, connect a custom domain, and remove Aglyn branding.

items.title: Invite and hand off
items.body: Give the client and your team the exact roles they need, and manage billing from one hub.

items.title: Console
items.body: Run every site, team, and setting in one place.

items.title: Besigner
items.body: Design on a live canvas and publish in one click.

items.title: Plugins
items.body: Install templates & layouts, or publish your own.

sections.heading: Run your agency on Aglyn.
body: Start free, add clients as you grow, and manage every site from one console.
